outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your practice areas
outreach_draft.body:
Ben,

I noticed Employment, Personal Injury, Family, Criminal and Civil Rights all share the same main Practice Areas experience on the site.

Those matters may sit under one firm, but the people looking for them are arriving with very different questions. A parent dealing with custody or divorce needs a very different conversation from someone facing a criminal charge or an employee dealing with discrimination.

Dedicated pages for the main practices could:
- speak directly to that type of client
- give Google a focused page to crawl and index
- give AI tools clearer context about each area of the firm’s work

I’m using Family Law as the first mockup example because the difference in client journey is especially easy to show.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
